title: SepsisFlow: an event-stream foundation model for continuous risk warning and trajectory modelling in ICU sepsis
abstract: arXiv:2611.13661v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sepsis is a leading cause of ICU death with heterogeneous onset and course, yet most warning models predict only whether sepsis will occur, leaving clinicians uncertain of its onset context and early trajectory once an alarm sounds. To answer these questions on one hourly clock from ICU admission, we built SepsisFlow: before onset, it combines a Mamba model pretrained on 2.57 million EHRs with about 1,700 hourly features in gradient-boosted trees to predict 6/12/24-h risk; at onset, it fuses Mamba and tabular encoders via a gated network into continuous patient states defining onset contexts; after onset, it encodes 72-h organ-support and physiological trajectories via an attention bidirectional recurrent network into early courses. For pre-onset warning in MIMIC-IV, SepsisFlow detected more cases than NEWS2, qSOFA, and SIRS at equal alarms, gaining about 8 cases per 100 from hourly updating, while outperforming 16 retrained algorithms a

translated_title: SepsisFlow：用于ICU脓毒症持续风险预警与病程轨迹建模的事件流基础模型
translated_abstract: 脓毒症是ICU患者死亡的主要原因之一，其发病与病程具有高度异质性，然而大多数预警模型仅预测脓毒症是否会发生，一旦警报响起，临床医生对其发病情境和早期病程轨迹仍缺乏了解。为了在从ICU入院开始的统一小时级时间轴上回答这些问题，我们构建了SepsisFlow：在发病前，它将基于257万份电子健康记录预训练的Mamba模型与约1700个每小时特征相结合，通过梯度提升树预测6/12/24小时发病风险；在发病时，它通过门控网络融合Mamba编码器与表格编码器，生成连续的患者状态以刻画发病情境；在发病后，它通过带注意力机制的双向循环网络编码72小时的器官支持与生理轨迹，形成早期病程刻画。在MIMIC-IV数据集上的发病前预警评估中，在相同警报次数下，SepsisFlow检出的病例数多于NEWS2、qSOFA和SIRS，通过每小时更新每100例额外检出约8例，同时优于16个重新训练的对比算法。
tldr: SepsisFlow是一个基于257万份电子病历预训练Mamba模型的事件流基础模型，可在ICU脓毒症发病前实现6/12/24小时风险预警、发病时刻画发病情境、发病后建模72小时早期病程轨迹，其预警性能优于NEWS2、qSOFA、SIRS等传统评分及16种重训算法。
en_tdlr: SepsisFlow is an event-stream foundation model pretrained on 2.57 million EHRs with a Mamba architecture that enables pre-onset 6/12/24-h risk prediction, onset-context characterization through fused patient states, and post-onset 72-h trajectory modeling for ICU sepsis, outperforming NEWS2, qSOFA, SIRS and 16 retrained algorithms.
